## Qwen 3.6 35B A3B E2EE API

Qwen 3.6 35B A3B E2EE is a large language model by Alibaba Qwen, available on the Venice API as `e2ee-qwen3-6-35b-a3b`. This model supports end-to-end encryption (E2EE) and runs in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). Your prompt is encrypted on your client and decrypted inside a verified TEE. The response is then encrypted and sent back to your client for decryption. Venice's system prompt and web search are disabled to preserve end-to-end encryption. Attestation evidence is available for independent verification. It is also available without end-to-end encryption, as [Qwen 3.6 35B A3B](/models/qwen-3-6-35b-a3b).

Qwen 3.6 35B A3B FP8 running in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). A fast mixture-of-experts model with \~3B active parameters per token. Hardware attestation evidence is available for independent verification of enclave identity and configuration.

### How to use the Qwen 3.6 35B A3B E2EE API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "e2ee-qwen3-6-35b-a3b"` and your API key.

This sample sends the prompt as plaintext, so the request runs TEE-only. For end-to-end encryption, send encrypted messages with the E2EE headers, as the [TEE and E2EE guide](/guides/features/tee-e2ee-models#e2ee-models) shows.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "e2ee-qwen3-6-35b-a3b",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }]
  }'
```
